posts.author: AyyLmaonnaise
posts.body: Predictions: 11 of 11 Pending | Tied for 1st with 283 others Nazimov vs. GustavoIlkhom Nazimov, TKO, R1Gustavo is a fun brawler so this is a good matchup for Nazimov, but I do think he’s a little overrated for the last win. He is a stick striker with insane ko power but he dos seem kind of fragile. That being said, Gustavo is going to fight the type of fight he wants, and I think Nazimov will spark himOta vs. HokamuraShinobu Ota, TKO, R2Ota should take this fairly easily. His record is terrible but he’s also taken a ton of very tough fights. Hes pretty limited and his wrestling in MMA isn’t even that good considering his elite background. He should dominate this fight thoughTakagi vs. LiRyo Takagi, TKO, R3This is a banger, Rizin is a good landing spot for Li Kaiwen. He’s not good enough to make the ufc but he should have success here. Kaiwen is really fun but he is a limited brawler; when he can’t trade in the pocket he just sits back at range and stares. He had some sick wars on RTU but he’s not overly skilled. Takagi will strike with him but I think he’s a better technician an can fight a smart gameplan. Kaiwen does not have a great process

posts.author: Robwett
posts.body: Predictions: 11 of 11 Pending | Tied for 1st with 283 others Nazimov vs. GustavoIlkhom Nazimov, TKO, R1Nazimov is awesome although I don't think he's as good as people are saying just because he managed to catch Satoshi. This is a very good matchup for him since Gustavo is a careless brawler but I don't expect him to stay champ for too longTakagi vs. LiRyo Takagi, DECAwesome to see Kaiwen Li in RIZIN but unfortunately for him he's making his debut against one of the better guys in the promotion. Takagi is a very well rounded fighter and did better against Akimoto than anybody else that fought him (except Motoya)Ota vs. HokamuraShinobu Ota, TKO, R2Ota hasn't looked great lately but to be fair to him he has been fighting some of the best guys on the Japanese scene. He should be able to beat Kintaro who has been looking very washed when he isn't pulling heel hooks out of nowhereOyama vs. PerezKeito Oyama, DECLotus has looked pretty solid in her recent fights. She got held down for 15 min in her last fight and still outdamaged Oshima from her back in the last round, if they scored that fight with old RIZIN rules she would have won. This seems like a layup for her to get a winSaika vs. UsamiTatsuya Saika, TKO, R1On paper this is a matchup for Usami to win, he's a pretty high level boxer going against a guy that just swings everything full power with no regard to his own safety. I used to be pretty high on Usami but unfortunately he has locked so bad in his recent fights, his latest win was a horribly boring decision that he easily could have lost. I'm picking the guy that actually goes out there and tries to do somethingMatsushima vs. CafaroKoyomi Matsushima, DECVery interesting matchup here. Cafaro is on a solid winstreak but Matsushima is a very well rounded fighter. I think Matsushima might win this by crafty decisionTsubota vs. UmenoDaiki Tsubota, DECI love Umeno and Tsubota is very chinny but I can't pick Umeno to win against a experienced MMA fighter after he struggled to grapple with AshizawaShishimoto vs. KodamaRyoma Shishimoto, SUB, R1Kodama falls victim to the RIZIN kickboxer humiliation ritual of debuting against a guy with some gnarly BJJAmeyama vs. HiramotoSeiya Ameyama, TKO, R1Ameyama has some killer finishing instinct and Hiramoto is only in RIZIN thanks to his brother, he hasn't really impressed me. Ameyama should be able to find a finish here
